most_defensible_statement: Y* is not just an agent framework or readiness consultant; it is a trust/action layer that asks whether an agent action is evidenced, authorized, contained, receipted, and learnable before it becomes real.
strongest_commercial_capability: A paid preflight/black-box review for a proposed agent action or agent rollout.
strongest_unique_fitness: Y* uniquely connects epistemic boundary, action legitimacy, execution containment, accountability, strategic cognition, and learning legitimacy into one governed action loop.
